verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and self-contained. The forward implication constructs an injection from each subset S into N(S) using the saturating matching. The converse is proved by induction on |X|: a proper tight subset yields compatible matchings on two induced subgraphs, while in the absence of a proper tight subset deleting the endpoints of a chosen edge preserves the neighborhood inequalities. The two cases cover all possibilities, and no prohibited justification or unchecked reference occurs.
